products.description:
Chrome Parallel Cards

Ultra-rare Chrome and Opal Chrome pattern Topps NOW® parallels will unlock for cards with large print runs at specific tiers as additional lucky parallels:

50,000+ Print Run: Look for Chrome parallels /99 and /50 + lower parallel structure.

100,000+ Print Run: Look for Chrome parallels /25, /10, /5 and 1/1 SuperFractor + lower parallel structure.

250,000+ Print Run: Look for Opal Chrome parallels /50, /25, /10 and /5 + lower parallel structure.

500,000+ Print Run: Look for 1/1 White OpalFractor Chrome + lower parallel structure.

Capturing all the excitement of Major League Baseball – Topps NOW brings the biggest moments on the diamond directly to your collection!

Your Hero. Your Team. Your Moment. ™

Topps NOW celebrates the greatest moments... as they happen! Only available at Topps.com. Print runs for every card are released in the MLB Topps NOW Archive.
Learn About the Topps NOW® Brand

All sales are final. Print runs revealed after sales window expires. Art subject to change. Not responsible for typographical/printer errors. In an effort to mitigate our carbon footprint, shipments may be grouped together within the same order. Large orders may be consolidated into bulk packaging at Topps’ discretion.

PLAYERS CHOICE DIAMOND CLUB®
